baselines.tuning: none; same governed penalty fixed before run

bootstrap.statistic: Mean within-repeat OOF AUROC; same resampled patient multiplicities applied to every model and repeat. Paired AUROC differences. Percentile95%CI conditional on these fitted models; seed spread reported separately, no independence assumption across repeated patients.

conditional_secondary_claim_rule: Canonical shared_patch must have mean AUROC greater than each C-only/X-only/concatenated, paired patient-bootstrap95%CI lower bound >0 against each, and higher AUROC in >=4/5 repeated CV seeds. Do not change endpoint, architecture, budget, seeds or penalty after viewing results. Day60 reported regardless of ranking and any discordance stated.
context_time_contract: Raw context preserves degenerate columns. Recorded laboratory values restricted to validated initial regimen start; other registry covariates lack verified individual timestamps. No claim all covariates verified pretreatment.

historical_recipe_sensitivity.applies_to: observed_conversion only; not eligible to replace shared_patch for the conditional manuscript claim

initialization_sensitivity: Death/failure only: also fit seeds0,1,2,3 on fixed seed42 folds to distinguish optimization variation. Seed42 result shared with repeated CV. No best-seed selection.
manuscript_policy: Exact original PATCH_Final_V3_EW.docx unchanged until results support a narrow tracked correction. Death/failure remains primary. No broad prose/clinical narrative/figure rearrangement changes.
preprocessing: Fit numeric imputation/scaling, categorical vocabulary/drop rules, and >=1% regimen vocabulary within each training fold. No global encoding or feature prevalence filtering. Same train/test matrices all models.
primary: death_failure: recorded Died/Failure versus Cured/Completed; all other final outcomes excluded. No culture requirement.
privacy: All patient-derived objects remain local and in memory. No IDs, labels, predictions, clinical values, coefficient/embedding/latent arrays serialized. Only aggregate endpoint/seed metrics and cohort counts>=30; failure logs contain no messages or locals.
reporting: Report each seed and descriptive mean, median, range. Mean AUROC across repeats, not best seed, pooled repeated rows or prediction ensemble.
secondary: observed_conversion: governed CONSORT, first observed positive culture <= day 0; first subsequent negative with no later recorded positive. Current integral-day parsing and whole-condition quarantine of conflicting same-day statuses. 0=censored/no recorded sustained conversion, not confirmed biological nonconversion. No two-negative confirmation; variable follow-up. New validation, not identical-label historical replay.
secondary_fixed_horizon_sensitivity: day60_negative: same baseline-positive eligibility, observed culture nearest day60 in inclusive45-75 window; equal distance chooses earlier day. Exclude missing window culture, do not code it0. Status1=negative,0=positive. Observed microbiological status, not WHO-confirmed conversion or cure.
split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold, patient grouped; all models same folds each repeat. Each repeat jointly changes fold seed and PATCH initialization seed.
unevaluable_policy: If either class or total patient count <30, suppress counts and report endpoint not evaluable; do not modify eligibility, seeds, folds or models.
